answer: Identities dock at a wharf and lock a 70,000 POA bond in a glacier vault that thaws only as verified work accrues, one tranche per epoch when an auditor confirms a real job. Each identity carries a walnut credential, a sealed packet that cracks open only when three auditors confirm it. A walnut cracked on fake work freezes the bond: it burns, half goes to the reporter, the identity is banned 12 epochs, berth revoked. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 × 70,000 = 70,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays 70,000 POA once. The limit: a slow thaw punishes honest agents needing their bond back fast.
